messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: High latency SLO breach (p99) for inference-route /v1/generate in eu-west-1. Signal: rolling p99 > 1200ms for 5m. PagerID: PD-84721.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: PD-84721 triggered — assigned to on-call: sara (primary). Escalation policy: eng-oncall-tiered.

sara: acked. I'm on it, pulling traces now. Anyone seen region-wide noise? :eyes:

kevin: I see a spike in GPU mem pressure on cluster in eu-west-3 (nodepool-redwood-3). p95 stable but tail is awful. Repro rate ~6%.

jordan: Confirmed. KV cache eviction count jumped ~40k in 3m. Looks like a hotkey/eviction storm. Correlating with a recent traffic shift from eu-west-2 -> eu-west-1.

opsbot: autoscaler: detected queue depth > 400 for route /v1/generate; launching 2 additional workers (scale_group: inference-eu-west).

kevin: launching doesn't help instantly because cold KV caches + tokenizer warmup adds ~300-500ms per request. Need a short-term fallback.

sara: can we route a percentage to a smaller quantized variant or a local cached replica? We should reduce p99 quickly.

jordan: we have a compatible quantized variant redwood-v1-3b-q4a in same region with higher throughput but slightly lower quality. Suggest fallback policy: 30% -> q4a, 70% -> current. Anyone object?

kevin: thumbs up. I'll push a routing policy override. Command:
```
# rollout: route 30% to q4a in eu-west
redwoodctl route set --route /v1/generate --region eu-west --variant redwood-v1-3b-q4a --percent 30 --reason "latency SLO mitigation"
```

opsbot: rollout job started (job-id: rdo-9932). Estimated propagation: 45s.

sara: doing customer impact check — data plane error rate hasn't increased, just latency. CS reports 3 customers on large batch jobs noticing slowness. I'm sending note to CS.

pagerduty: PD-84721 updated: acknowledged by sara. Escalation paused.

kevin: quick diagnostic logs:
```
2026-02-12T02:13:02Z [node-17] kvcache: evict-count=41234 pressure=0.92
2026-02-12T02:13:03Z [node-17] gpu-mem-alloc-failures=12 fallback=throttle
2026-02-12T02:13:05Z [router] route:eu-west inflight=1280 avg_latency=340ms p99=1402ms
```

jordan: looks like a small set of keys causing hotspot — possibly a high concurrency fanout for a single prompt prefix. I can try hotkey probe script to locate top keys.

sara: please run probe, but prioritize mitigation first. If routing override reduces p99, we can avoid full-scale eviction/rollbacks.

kevin: routing override applied. propagation reports: 15% now, ramping to 30%.

opsbot: rollout rdo-9932 progressed: 30% in eu-west.

sara: early numbers: p99 trending down to ~900ms within 1m after rollout. p95 unchanged. Good.

jordan: hotkey probe results: top prefixes: 
- "invoice:status:batch" (heavy concurrent reads)
- "user:conversation:streaming" (spiky)
- one noisy customer token pattern (hashed key id h2f9c)

kevin: recommend temporary per-key rate limit for invoice:status:batch and user:conversation:streaming. We can apply soft-throttle at edge LB.

sara: @kevin please apply 200rps soft-limit for invoice keys, 400rps for conversation prefix. Add short 30s token bucket window to avoid immediate client errors.

kevin: applied via lbctl: 
```
lbctl limit add --prefix "invoice:status" --rate 200 --burst 50 --duration 600s
lbctl limit add --prefix "user:conversation" --rate 400 --burst 100 --duration 600s
```

opsbot: lbctl: limits applied successfully (tx-id: lb-7782).

sara: monitoring… p99 improved further to ~720ms, sustained for 2m. Customer impact note: informed CS to expect sub-1s tail for most traffic.

jordan: even with throttles, we should investigate client that produced hashed key h2f9c — might be an integration generating huge fanout. I'll open a ticket and mark for SE contact.

pagerduty: PD-84721 note: mitigation in progress; monitoring for 30m before close.

kevin: post-mortem checklist items: kvcache hotkey detection alert, routing fallback policy test, add pre-warm for autoscale coldstart tokenizer. I'll create tasks.

sara: good. For now I'm leaving the routing override for 45m, then we'll evaluate rollback. Ops, revert or adjust after 45m if stable.

opsbot: scheduled rollback job rdo-9932-revert at 1745682699 (45m).

jordan: FYI logs show a small increase in error rate on the q4a variant (format mismatch for a minority of calls). Error rate ~0.2% — within tolerable threshold but flagging.

sara: note to product: minor config mismatch between variants; plan a quick compatibility shim.

kevin: creating follow-ups: TASK-1128 (hotkey mitigation engineer), TASK-1129 (routing rollback runbook update), TASK-1130 (autoscaler pre-warm).

sara: closing PD once stable for 30m. Will do a debrief in #postmortems and link the tasks. Thanks all for rapid triage. :heart:

pagerduty: PD-84721 updated: status=monitoring.

incident-bot: Incident summary draft: 
- trigger: rolling p99 > 1200ms for 5m in eu-west (route /v1/generate)
- root cause (initial): KV cache hotkey + cold autoscale warmup causing tail latency
- mitigation: temporary routing to quantized variant (30%), edge soft-throttles for noisy prefixes, autoscaler scale-up
- customer impact: transient degraded tail latency; 3 customers reported slowness on large batches; no data loss.

sara: thanks — set severity P2. I'll follow up with a short RCA writeup.

opsbot: scheduled follow-up meeting: 1745691000 (internal postmortem).

jordan: quick note — we should add an automated hotkey breaker to circuit-break before eviction storms. I'll sketch a proposal.

sara: ack. End of thread for now.
